sentences.text:
Ram Niwas@Pappu S/O Rudmal B/C Yadav vs State Of
Rajasthan on 17 December, 2019

Author: Ashok Kumar Gaur
Bench: Ashok Kumar Gaur
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur
 S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 17475/2019
Ram Niwas@Pappu S/o Rudmal B/c Yadav, R/o Lisadiya Dist.
Sikar At Present Lodged In The Sub Jail Srimadhopur Dist.

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Sikar
 ----Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp
 ----Respondent
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Ashwin Garg Adv.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mangal Singh Saini, P.P.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ASHOK KUMAR GAUR Order 17/12/2019 The present Misc. Bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

The petitioner was arrested in a case arising out of FIR No.511/2019, registered at Police Station Srimadhopur, District Sikar for the offence(s) under Sections 420, 407, 379, 272, 273, 120B IPC and Sections 51, 52, 57 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

Learned Counsel for the petitioner submitted that the Co- accused-Oparam@Papu has been granted Bail by this Court in S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 17060/2019 (Oparam@papu Vs. State of Rajasthan) dt. 12th December, 2019.

entities.text: S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 17060/2019 (Oparam@papu Vs. State of Rajasthan)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Counsel submitted that the allegation leveled against the petitioner and co-accused-Oparam@Papu is identical (2 of 2) [CRLMB-17475/2019] and the matter pertains to stealing of milk from tanker.
Counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is not having any criminal antecedents.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

Considering the contentions put forth by counsel for the petitioner and considering the parity in respect of indulgence granted by this Court to the co-accused Oparam@Papu & without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case,
this Court is inclined to accept the bail application.

Accordingly, the present bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner Ram Niwas@Pappu S/o Rudmal shall be enlarged on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates Ram Niwas@Pappu S/O Rudmal B/C Yadav vs State Of Rajasthan on 17 December, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152963052/
